company.name: Regulate
company.tagline: Empowering healthy, high-performing organisations with breathwork tailored for the workday.
company.description:
Regulate is on a mission to empower healthy, high-performing organisations with breathwork tailored for the workday. We believe that breathwork is the most efficient and straightforward way to regulate your state. And although it may sound esoteric to some it is solidly backed by science and breathwork is already embraced by leading figures in business, entertainment and sports for its transformative power. Don’t miss your chance to experience what they already know.

With our live sessions, we offer functional and transformative breathwork experiences. And with our app we guide you with the right breathwork at the right time, helping you build and maintain an impactful routine. To regulate you to anything from more balanced, energised, calm to stimulating your creativity and mental fitness. Our approach is backed by research and infused with years of hands-on business experience from our founder, Peter van Woerkum, a certified Breathwork and Leadership Coach, who has worked with high-performing executives to help them harness the power of breath.

By merging proven techniques with immersive experiences, Regulate is redefining how professionals manage their mental health in the fast-paced business world. Are you ready to change your state at will? 

Sign up for our newsletter today and be among the first to access the breathwork revolution!
